dedupe_keys.name: mimii dataset sound dataset for malfunctioning industrial machine investigation and inspection

description: MIMII is a sound dataset of normal and malfunctioning industrial machines for machine fault diagnosis research. The Zenodo record says it covers four machine types (valves, pumps, fans and slide rails), seven individual product models per type, with 5,000 to 10,000 seconds of normal sound and about 1,000 seconds of anomalous sound per model, recorded with an eight-channel microphone array at 16 kHz and 16 bit; anomalies include contamination, leakage, rotating unbalance and rail damage, and background noise recorded in real factories was mixed in at three signal-to-noise levels. It was published by seven Hitachi, Ltd. researchers in September 2019 (version "public 1.0") as twelve zip files of about 100 GB in total, free under CC BY-SA 4.0. Coverage is laboratory recordings of the listed machine models. Caveats: the recordings are of machines in a test setting with added factory noise, not of in-service plant, and the successor MIMII DUE dataset (Zenodo 4740101, 2021, domain shifts from operating and environmental changes) is listed as restricted on Zenodo with no open files. For simulation it gives labelled acoustic signatures of pump, fan and valve faults to train condition monitoring that feeds equipment failure rates into plant and utility asset models. Related catalogue records include the NASA prognostics data repository and the Tennessee Eastman process anomaly detection data.
